children: SK Hynix has dropped plans for a potential U.S. listing of its memory-chip unit Solidigm, citing market conditions.

An initial public offering was under review by Solidigm as part of efforts to explore funding options for a new fabrication facility in the U.S. to meet growing demand for AI memory chips, SK Hynix said Friday.

"While an IPO was expected to ease investment burdens and expand capacity for shareholder returns, the review has been discontinued in light of market conditions and share price trends," the company said.
